audit.whatIsWrong: Rated FAVOURED at 4/10 while Akali wins 47.04% of 3848 games, and the level chart gave Akali all seven rows — the packet flags this contradiction explicitly.
audit.why: A sub-50% win rate cannot carry a 7/0 chart and a FAVOURED label. The kits explain where the loss comes from: Twisted Fate is a ranged mage whose Wild Cards pierces minions, against a melee champion with no defensive tool until Twilight Shroud at level 3. Levels 1-2 are his outright; 3 to 5 even out once the shroud exists; Akali takes over from 6 as her burst outgrows his.
audit.corrected: EVEN, 5.5/10, carry threat 6/10. Chart becomes Twisted Fate / Twisted Fate / Skill / Skill / Akali / Akali / Akali.

audit.why: Level 6 genuinely is Akali's: Perfect Execution is 120s but Destiny is 170s at rank 1 and adds no lane damage at all. First item and two items stay hers.
audit.corrected: Kept the Akali framing on rows 4-6, added Destiny's 170s downtime as the dive window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text repeatedly calls Pick a Card a 'blind stun' and describes him 'blinking in for a card pickup'. Neither exists in his kit. The one interaction that decides the matchup was never stated.
audit.why: Pick a Card locks a card into his NEXT ATTACK — gold stuns, and it is delivered by an auto-attack at 200 range. Twilight Shroud makes Akali 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks', so a shrouded Akali cannot be gold-carded at all: the lock sits there with nowhere to go. Wild Cards, by contrast, is an untargeted projectile and passes through the smoke unchanged. He has no blind and no blink.
audit.corrected: Shroud denies the gold card auto; it does not deny Wild Cards. Pick a Card cycles on a flat 6s, so the punish is the spent auto, not the cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Advice said to commit 'on Pick a Card's cooldown'.
audit.why: Pick a Card is a flat 6 seconds at every rank — it is never meaningfully down, so waiting for it is not a plan. Wild Cards is 6s falling to 5s. Destiny at 170s is the only long cooldown in his kit and is the real window.
audit.corrected: Punish the spent gold auto and Destiny's downtime; stop counting Pick a Card.
sources: brief enemyKit W cd 6, Q cd 6/5.75/5.5/5.25/5, R cd 170/140/110

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged 'Wild Card' (singular) as a wrong name.
audit.why: The ability is Wild Cards. 'Your Perfect Execution' is a packet false positive — that is Akali's own R, correctly named.
audit.corrected: Singular use replaced with Wild Cards.

audit.whatIsWrong: Whether Destiny's reveal strips Twilight Shroud's invisibility is not answerable from the kit text.
audit.why: Riot's Destiny text says it reveals all enemy champions; Riot's Shroud text says Akali is invisible and unselectable. The text does not say which wins. I asserted nothing and raised it as a question.

notes: This matchup had the packet's own flagged contradiction: 47.04% win rate with a 7/0 Akali level chart and a FAVOURED 4/10 label. I rebalanced it to EVEN 5.5/10 with Twisted Fate taking levels 1-2 and the chart evening at 3-5, and proposed the full and content chart rows as matched pairs plus the ratings, diff, diffRating, carryRating and tone as one group. Killed two fabricated mechanics: Twisted Fate has no blind (the text called Pick a Card a 'blind stun' twice) and no blink for 'card pickup'. Added the interaction the whole matchup turns on and which appeared nowhere: gold card is delivered by an AUTO-ATTACK, and Twilight Shroud makes Akali unselectable by attacks, so the shroud hard-denies it — while Wild Cards is untargeted and goes through the smoke regardless. Also corrected 'Wild Card' to Wild Cards; 'Your Perfect Execution' was a packet false positive. NOT asserted, and flagged as a question: whether Destiny's champion reveal defeats Twilight Shroud. | COHERENCE: 2 chart edit(s) withdrawn — they moved the row to the enemy while leaving the phase why describing the owner winning it. Chart authority is an open question, so the label was reverted rather than the prose rewritten. Re-propose only as a side+why pair.
